description: The German electricity system in 2030: data on consumption, generation, and the grid is a data set deposited in tib.kit by its authors Frederik Vom Scheidt, Carmen Müller. This publication includes data for the German electricity system in 2030 and a corresponding documentation of the methodology of data acquisition and preprocessing. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Namensnennung 4.0 International. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
